text:
Matt: quick sync - want a compact "grace" signal from adapters (soft vs hard) so runtime/telemetry can distinguish.
Sara: +1 — nil hides cases where route is acceptable but not preferred.
Jin: what's minimal shape? perf at scale matters.
Matt: propose: evaluate() -> status ∈ {ACCEPT, SOFT_FALLBACK, HARD_FALLBACK}, candidate? Route, reason_enum?, priority_delta?
Ben: runtime can still use SOFT_FALLBACK but tag metrics and optionally deprioritize. sensible.
Carla: require small enum set (capacity_limited, latency_degraded, quality_tradeoff). freeform only for sampled logs.
Sara: ops asks for metric soft_fallback_rate per tenant/model/region; alert if >5% for 5m on prod tiers.
Jin: perf: status byte + small ints for enums/delta, reuse candidate pointer -> negligible.
Ben: migration path? many v1 adapters return Optional<Route>.
Matt: runtime supports both; v1 mapped to HARD_FALLBACK by shim. v2 emits SOFT_FALLBACK.
Carla: tests: ordering with soft fallbacks, canary on Dedicated, sim for 24h traces to detect thrash.
Sara: I'll open PR for adapter types + shim tests.
Jin: I'll add telemetry fields + sim harness.
Ben: docs + migration checklist.
Matt: one open q: should policy expose priority_delta so SLA can override ordering?
Jin: propose optional priority_delta:int; default 0, maybe +10 for soft. runtime ignores when tenant SLA==strict.
Sara: keep it optional and small.
ops-bot: ticket INF-1427 created and assigned.
Matt: thanks — ping when PR is ready and we'll update the RFC.
